hero.label: Made for PointOne
hero.headline: I want to help PointOne own legal tech's AI billing moment.
hero.subheadline: Law firms are sitting on a massive timekeeping problem, and PointOne is building the AI layer to fix it. I've spent the last year doing exactly what this role demands: finding the right prospects, earning their attention, and moving them toward a yes. I'd love to bring that energy to a product with this much real-world urgency.

whyCompany.title: Legal billing is broken and AI is finally the right fix
whyCompany.body: Attorneys lose billable hours every day to manual timekeeping, and the problem is well-documented but historically undersolved. PointOne is attacking it with an AI-native platform at exactly the moment law firms are becoming more open to adopting this kind of tooling. That's a rare product-market timing window and I want to be part of the team that capitalizes on it.

whyCompany.title: Early SDR hire means outsized impact and real ownership
whyCompany.body: At a company this early, the first SDRs don't just fill a pipeline slot, they help define how the sales motion actually works. I'm not looking for a seat at a big company where I follow a rigid playbook. I want to help build one, learn directly from the founder, and grow with the company as it scales.

whyCompany.title: My BDR reps experience maps directly to this outbound role
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach campaigns end-to-end using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences, and contributed to acquiring 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch. More recently at NextAfter I sharpened my understanding of how messaging and positioning move B2B buyers in a consultative sale. Selling an AI platform to skeptical law firm partners will require exactly that combination of persistence and precision.

quote: Legal tech is having its real moment right now, and PointOne feels like the team that actually understands what attorneys need. I want to be the person opening those doors.
